title: ASVS verification findings
description: Input for scripts/asvs-report.py. Record only decisions; the script adds level, rule text and CWE from the rules files and computes the summary.

scope.description: What was verified: repository, directory, diff or PR, design document, configuration.

level.description: Target ASVS level. Findings may only reference rules at this level or below.

inventory.description: Security-relevant features found in scope (not the technology stack).

skipped_chapters.description: Chapter id -> reason it was not verified.

sections_na.description: Section id -> reason the whole section is not applicable. Its rules are not listed in findings.

evidence.description: Concrete location (`path:line`), test name or config key, and what it shows. Required for PASS, FAIL and PARTIAL.

reason.description: For N/A: why the requirement does not apply. For UNVERIFIED: what evidence is missing.

why.description: For FAIL and PARTIAL: what an attacker gains from this gap in this application, in one or two sentences. The renderer prefixes the CWE name and its typical consequence; use this for the application-specific part.

remediation.description: What to change, where. Required for FAIL and PARTIAL.

top_risks.description: Most important failures first, in the reviewer's words, each naming the requirement id.

missing_evidence.description: What the reviewer would need to settle the UNVERIFIED rules.
